about: Each setting is the one the page named beside it gave on the date read, quoted in page_text. A setting the pages do not give is marked decided, with why. Read the pages again before relying on the preset: a service changes what it asks for.

gerber.page_altium: Altium Designer 26.1.1; the page says the dialogs are unchanged in 24 and 25

fab_jlcpcb.description: JLCPCB's fabrication and assembly outputs: Gerber RS-274X in mm 4:4 with the board profile as the outline, NC Drill Excellon in inches 2:5 with plated and non-plated holes apart, a BOM in CSV and a pick and place in CSV, in mm, all in one folder.

page_text.format: Decimal: 0.0001 mm (a 4:4 coordinate format, giving 0.1 micron resolution)
page_text.layers: Board Outline (.GM); Top Layer (.GTL) and Bottom Layer (.GBL); Top Overlay (.GTO) and Bottom Overlay (.GBO); Top Solder (.GTS) and Bottom Solder (.GBS); Top Paste (.GTP) and Bottom Paste (.GBP)
page_text.board_profile: Board Outline (.GM) is the standard profile ... plot only one outline layer
page_text.rs274x: choose the Gerber option (not Gerber X2) ... RS-274X settings on the Advanced tab

decided.origin: The page gives no Gerber origin; absolute, the origin it gives for the drill files ('Coordinate Positions: Reference to absolute origin'), so the Gerbers and the drills line up.
decided.copper: Every copper layer Altium has (Top, Mid Layer 1 to 30, Internal Plane 1 to 16, Bottom): Altium writes a file only for those in the board's stack (probed on a 2-layer board, 2026-11-15), so the inner layers of a 4- or 6-layer board are in the set without naming them.
decided.aperture_tolerance: The page's 'Plus 0.00013mm, Minus 0.00013mm' is Altium's default of 50 internal units (0.005 mil, 0.000127 mm) as Altium shows it in mm; kept at 50.

page_text.zeroes: Leading/Trailing Zeroes: Keep leading and trailing zeroes
page_text.origin: Coordinate Positions: Reference to absolute origin
page_text.separate_plated: Generate separate NC Drill files for plated & non-plated holes (ticked)

page_text.format: BOM file is a simple text file in comma separated form (csv)
page_text.columns: Next column is the Designator ... The next one that is the Footprint or package ... The last column is LCSC part number (the first is Comment)
page_text.part_number: add a new parameter named LCSC Part # to our part

decided.group_by: The page gives no grouping; one row per part (same comment, footprint and part number), its designators together, as the page's own example rows list several designators.

bom.page_text: must contain: Comment, Designator, Footprint (bom); The last column is LCSC part number ... add a new parameter named LCSC Part # to our part (bom_altium)

cpl.page_text: Designator; Mid X/Mid Y: The X/Y coordinate of the component centroid. Required units: Metric(mm).; Layer: Top / Bottom, the board side where the component should be placed.; Rotation: The rotation of the component given in degrees. Positive values are counter clockwise.
cpl.decided: Mid X and Mid Y are written as plain numbers in mm, 4 decimals, as Altium's mm file gives them: the page names the unit, not a suffix.

zip.page_text: Archive types are .zip and .rar only; the structure must be flat, with the files at the top level rather than inside a nested subfolder.
